newsitem.title: USA: U.S. approves new five-year oil, gas leasing plan.
newsitem.headline: U.S. approves new five-year oil, gas leasing plan.

text.p: U.S. Interior Secretary Bruce Babbitt approved a new offshore oil and gas leasing plan for 1997 through 2002, the Minerals Management Service said Thursday.
The new leasing program includes 16 possible sales, with annual sales set for the Central and Western Gulf of Mexico.
One sale is being considered in the Eastern Gulf of Mexico off Alabama and in deep water more than 100 miles off Florida, and five sales are being considered in four areas off Alaska.
"No leasing is under consideration off the Atlantic or Pacific coasts," MMS said.
MMS said the five-year program reflected its attempt to balance the interests of coastal states, the public, the environmental community, and the oil and gas industry.
